name: Base
author: Adlux
description: Base storefront theme every new theme is built from: sale bar (rotating or countdown), header with menu drawer and search, cart drawer with live discounts and shipping protection, product page built from blocks (gallery, rating, price, swatch / pill / dropdown pickers, pack cards, buy buttons, trust icons, accordions, custom HTML), reviews with a write-a-review form, FAQ and content sections; home, collection, search, policy / contact / order-tracking pages and checkout.
